title: Banff PRIVATE Safari Drive and Custom Nature Walk -4H
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels

This tour is not suitable for individuals with mobility issues, back problems, recent surgeries, or serious medical conditions. Pregnant women are also advised to refrain from participating. Additionally, this tour is not designed for children under the age of 8.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Your journey begins with a private safari drive, where you'll traverse the park's scenic routes in a comfortable vehicle designed for optimal wildlife viewing. As you travel through the diverse environments of Banff, your knowledgeable guide will share fascinating insights into the region's ecology, history, and geology. While wildlife sightings cannot be guaranteed, your guide will take you to known hotspots where the chances of spotting animals such as elk, deer, bears, and various bird species are higher.

After your safari drive, embark on a custom nature walk tailored to your interests and fitness level. This portion of the excursion will lead you down lesser-known trails, allowing you to explore the tranquil beauty of the park away from the more crowded areas. 

Whether you're an avid nature enthusiast or a casual explorer, this private safari and nature walk offers a unique blend of adventure and education, all set against the backdrop of Banff's stunning wilderness.
